character_description: Young adult male in his mid-20s, bold and charismatic voice, fast-paced and energetic, daring and adventurous tone, smooth-talking with a hint of recklessness, confident gambler quality. Studio-quality recording.
audition_line: 哈哈，做生意就像跑长途运输一样，胆子大才能走得远！这票货我看准了，押上去，赢了吃肉，输了认栽。人生在世，不搏一把怎么知道自己的运气有多好？
